limits.dailyHelp: Maximum number of auto-approved replies per day. Excess messages go to the review queue.

autonomy.title: Graduated Autonomy
autonomy.subtitle: Configure per-category rules that control when the AI agent can auto-approve actions and when human review is required. Thresholds automatically adjust based on human feedback patterns.
autonomy.errorMessage: We hit an error loading autonomy rules. Reload to try again.
autonomy.emptyBody: Create rules to control how the AI agent handles different types of messages. Each category can have its own confidence threshold and daily limits.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1: The agent classifies each inbound message into a category.
howItWorks.step2: If confidence exceeds the threshold and daily limit is not reached, the action is auto-approved.
howItWorks.step3: Otherwise, the action goes to the review queue for human approval.
howItWorks.step4: Thresholds auto-adjust weekly based on rejection patterns. High rejections tighten the threshold; low rejections loosen it.

channels.title: Messaging channels
channels.subtitle: Connect and monitor the messaging integrations — SMS, WhatsApp, and webchat/webhooks — that reach your contacts beyond email. Once enabled, send a message to a contact from their Unified Timeline, and AI agent replies dispatch through them too. Email and team chat are built in and need no setup here; to configure email sending, set up your {transportLink} and a verified {domainLink}.
channels.emptyBodyAdmin: Use {action} above to configure a communication channel for your workspace.
channels.emptyBodyMember: Communication channels will appear here once an owner or admin has configured them for your workspace.

howItWorks.title: How Channels Work
howItWorks.step1: Each channel is an external messaging medium (SMS, WhatsApp, or a generic webhook).
howItWorks.step2: Channels use adapters to connect to their providers. Configure each channel's credentials below.
howItWorks.step3: Health monitoring runs automatically and reports status for each enabled channel.
howItWorks.step4: Inbound messages flow into the unified pipeline for every channel. Once a channel is enabled, send outbound from a contact's Unified Timeline — SMS, WhatsApp, and generic dispatch through their configured providers, alongside AI agent replies.
